name: find_calendar_event_by_name
description: Search for calendar events by name using semantic similarity. Returns the top matching events.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.description: The name or description of the event to search for.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the start of the search window. Defaults to 1 year ago.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the end of the search window. Defaults to 1 year from now.

outputs.description: Human-readable list of matching events with similarity scores.
